name: @pipeworx/mcp-vimeo

tools.name: video
tools.description: Fetch metadata for a single Vimeo video by numeric or string ID; returns title, description, duration, embed URLs, privacy settings, stats, and owner info.

tools.name: videos_search
tools.description: Search the Vimeo video library through the Vimeo API (api.vimeo.com/videos) with a free-text query, plus page, per_page, sort, direction, and filter parameters, authenticated with a Vimeo access token. Returns matching Vimeo videos with title, description, duration, link and embed URLs, owner, and play statistics. Answers which videos hosted on Vimeo match a subject, title, or creator name.

tools.name: user
tools.description: Fetch a Vimeo user's public profile by user_id or vanity URL name; returns display name, bio, location, follower/following counts, and upload quota.

tools.name: user_videos
tools.description: List videos uploaded by a Vimeo user (user_id); supports pagination (page, per_page) and sorting; returns video metadata array.

tools.name: channel
tools.description: Fetch metadata for a Vimeo channel by numeric ID or slug; returns channel name, description, subscriber count, video count, and privacy settings.

tools.name: channel_videos
tools.description: List videos in a Vimeo channel by channel ID or slug; supports pagination and sorting; returns video metadata array.

tools.name: categories
tools.description: Return the full list of top-level Vimeo content categories (e.g. Animation, Comedy, Music) with slugs usable in category_videos.

tools.name: category
tools.description: Fetch metadata for a single Vimeo category by slug; returns category name, icon, subcategories, and featured video count.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-vimeo forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the vimeo pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
